name: @icelily/dsh-gitbash-preset
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: installs the 'minimal-gitbash' agent preset — the Windows variant of the shipped minimal preset that routes the bash tool through Git for Windows bash (MSYS), with automatic shell discovery and honest unconfined reporting.

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check agent-presets/minimal-gitbash/gitbash-executor.mjs && node --check agent-presets/minimal-gitbash/test/gitbash-executor.test.mjs && node --check agent-presets/minimal-gitbash/test/shell-contract.test.mjs && node --check test/composition-sync.test.mjs

author: icelily
